colorMixing.title: Color mixing
colorMixing.empty: Blend two or more filaments into a new colour, then use it like any filament.
colorMixing.ratioHint: Alternates the filaments layer by layer in this ratio.
colorMixing.cycleHint: Repeats this layer sequence from the bottom up: 1122 is two layers of 1, then two of 2.
colorMixing.matchHint: Finds the mix of your filaments closest to a colour.
colorMixing.gradientHint: Fades from one filament to the other up the height of the object.
colorMixing.removeFilament: Remove this filament from the mix
colorMixing.differentTypes: Different filament types cannot be mixed. Please correct the settings.
colorMixing.sameColours: Same filament colours cannot produce new colours. Please select different colours for mixing.
